summary: Rewrote monthly_statement to send one /v2/settlements request with merchant_id, canonical tz, half-open from/to and BCP 47 locale (no deprecated params), and to round with Decimal per currency and format amounts per locale. The meridale-display page returned 403, so I rebuilt its rules from search snippets. The rounding page says half-up, but the changelog and the search index say half-even; I used half-even.
